semantics.rule: A skill tree is included when it has at least one selected category. Selecting BLADEMASTER and GUNNER returns the union, not the intersection.
semantics.display: Tags describe effect domains, not exclusive weapon ownership. Universal combat effects can carry both weapon tags.
semantics.overlapPolicy: Mixed combat effects may carry combat and Utility or Defense tags when each tag reflects a material canonical effect.

categories.BLADEMASTER: Direct benefits/penalties for blademaster weapon combat or universal combat effects that apply to blademaster attacks.
categories.GUNNER: Direct benefits/penalties for Bow, Light Bowgun, Heavy Bowgun, their ammo/coatings, or universal combat effects that apply to gunner attacks.
categories.DEFENSE: Reduces incoming damage, hostile status/control, exposure, or risk; includes survivability and defensive evasion/guard effects.
categories.UTILITY: Quest/build/resource, gathering, rewards, information, item/crafting, stamina-economy, or general convenience effects not primarily classified as combat offense/defense.
